items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Did you ever know a drummer named Rudolph? ... Rudolph Bollier. Bollier, that's right. He's kin to Arnold De Pears.

ctx.x: I thought maybe it's something you might remember when you were the old boy.
No, I wouldn't remember just anything. Did you ever know a drummer named Rudolph? Yeah. Who is he? Well he played with Sam quite a while too. Yeah, he played with Sam.
What does he look like? Which Rudolph is that? He's a heavy star bright fellow. That's the one who's alive now? Yeah.
